h1: The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa, Dolphin Bay Sam Roi Yot — Beachfront Resort, 72-Metre Pool & Private Pool Villas
intro: Picture this: you wake up, cross one quiet little road, and you're on the calm sands of Dolphin Bay, with the limestone peaks of Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park as a backdrop — no vendor stalls, no crowds of tourists, just the sound of waves and the sea breeze. The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa is a mid-sized beachfront resort of around 62 rooms set right on Dolphin Bay (Ao Loma), Sam Roi Yot sub-district, Sam Roi Yot district, Prachuap Khiri Khan province · what everyone talks about is the outdoor pool roughly 72 metres long that stretches down the middle of the resort, alongside rooms in the main buildings, beach villas, and private pool villas · beach villas start at around ฿3,000/night, with a rating of 3.7 out of 5 from 53 reviews on TripAdvisor · it's a resort that sells quiet and seaside privacy above all else, but there are a few things about its age and location you'll want to understand before booking.

Pool villa and rooms at The Privacy Beach Resort decorated in warm tones by the sea at Sam Roi Yot
The quiet Dolphin Bay beach in front of The Privacy Beach Resort with a mountain backdrop

body.html: The Privacy Beach Resort overview — who it's for — to put it as simply as possible, The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa is a resort for people who want to "escape the city and fall asleep to the sound of waves on a quiet beach" in a corner that still doesn't get many tourists · it isn't a sleek, brand-new luxury resort like the ones in central Hua Hin, and it isn't somewhere you can walk straight out to restaurants or nightlife · it's a mid-sized beachfront resort of around 62 rooms set on Dolphin Bay, Sam Roi Yot sub-district, Sam Roi Yot district, Prachuap Khiri Khan province, a stretch of coast that is far quieter and more natural than Hua Hin or Pranburi · the main draws are a pool roughly 72 metres long, a private beach in front of the resort, and a kind of quiet that's hard to find · the resort is still open, and on TripAdvisor it holds 3.7 out of 5 from 53 reviews, ranking around #10 of 16 hotels in the Sam Roi Yot area · real reviews agree that the people who fit best here are couples and families after a slow-life seaside getaway, who love swimming in a long pool and don't mind driving out for meals · on the flip side, anyone chasing buzz, restaurants and cafes within walking distance, or expecting brand-new 5-star rooms and facilities, may find it quiet, dated, and too far out · to be blunt: this is a resort that sells location and calm, not newness or the convenience of walking around.

Location and getting around — The Privacy Beach Resort sits right on Dolphin Bay beach in Sam Roi Yot district, a fair way south of Pranburi and Hua Hin · the upside of the location is the quiet, the private beach, and how close it is to Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park, the natural highlight of the area · driving from the resort to the park's attractions — like Phraya Nakhon Cave with its royal pavilion (Khuha Kharuehat) inside the cave, and the mangrove forest walking trail — doesn't take long · it's also near Sam Roi Yot Beach and the seaside viewpoints around here · the thing to say plainly is that the location is fairly remote and very quiet — from Dolphin Bay into Pranburi town takes around 30–40 min by car, and into central Hua Hin around 50–60 min, depending on traffic · there's no mall or large convenience store within walking distance of the resort, just a scattering of local eateries and village shops · many reviews stress that the area has no public transport, so you really want your own car or a rental, and it pays to plan and buy the essentials in advance · for flying in, the nearest and most convenient airport is Hua Hin (HHQ), or you can land at Suvarnabhumi/Don Mueang and drive down · if you don't mind driving, you trade it for quiet and nature you can't get in central Hua Hin.

"The moment we arrived it felt like we'd dropped out of all the chaos. The beach in front of the resort is so quiet — cross the road and you're at the sea · the pool is incredibly long, you can swim to your heart's content · but you have to accept it's remote, there's nothing around, and you have to drive out for every meal."

Room types and decor — The Privacy Beach Resort has around 62 rooms across several types, from studios and twin/single rooms in the main buildings to beach villas and private pool villas · rooms are air-conditioned, with a fridge/minibar, flat-screen TV, work desk, balcony or terrace, and a tiled en-suite bathroom with a shower and free toiletries · many villas have a sea or garden view, large windows that pull in the light, and clean white linens · the highlight reviewers mention is the group of pool villas and beach villas that are spacious and private, great for couples or families who want their own space by the sea · but to be straight with you, real reviews raise two important points · one is that the private pools in some pool villas are smaller than expected — many guests say the pool is a touch small, so if you're set on really enjoying a swim, the long central pool is the better bet · two is that some of the rooms and furniture are starting to show their age and look dated in line with the resort's vintage, with old-style decor and, in some rooms, signs of wear and the damp you get at seaside resorts · so it's worth choosing your room type and asking about the condition, or requesting photos of the actual room, before booking if you expect something brand new.

Facilities, the pool, and the spa — the centrepiece of the common areas is the outdoor pool roughly 72 metres long that runs down the middle of the resort, the main draw reviewers mention most · many praise it as big, long, and genuinely satisfying to swim, good for both people who want to do long laps and families who want the kids in the water · besides the long pool there's a separate kids' pool, a poolside bar to sit and sip a drink, and a seaside garden to stroll through · for unwinding there's a spa offering massages and treatments, a fitness room, a ballroom for functions and seminars, and an activity room for children · another standout is the quiet, private Dolphin Bay beach in front of the resort — cross one small road and you're there, with clear water in some seasons, perfect for a walk, watching the sun, and letting the kids play in the sand · the resort also has free bicycles to borrow, free parking, and Wi-Fi · to be honest, while the facilities cover what you'd want at a seaside resort, reviews note Wi-Fi that isn't very stable in some spots and beach cleanliness that, at times, has litter or seaweed washing in naturally, so keep that in mind.

Food and bars — the resort has a main restaurant called Siam Dining serving Thai and international food, both indoors and outdoors, with a seaside-resort atmosphere, plus a poolside bar for an evening drink · breakfast is served in the morning at set times · a number of reviews praise the food at the restaurant as tasty and the breakfast as a decent enough spread, with a quiet seaside setting to eat in · but to be straight with you, since there aren't many restaurants within walking distance of the resort, many guests end up relying mainly on the resort restaurant, or driving out to find local eateries around Sam Roi Yot · some voices in reviews feel the resort's food prices are on the high side for the area, and the menu choices can be limited at certain meals · the advice from reviews is that if you're staying several nights, plan to drive out and try the seafood and local restaurants in Sam Roi Yot and Pranburi districts too, where prices are friendlier and you get a community feel · overall, the food at The Privacy Beach Resort does the job for convenience, but it isn't the main reason to come.

Service — service is the area that earns fairly consistent praise in real reviews, and it's the resort's highest sub-score on TripAdvisor (around 4.1 out of 5) · several staff are mentioned as friendly, attentive, and genuinely trying to help, even if some have limited English · many international guests say the team is warm and willing to help, giving it that warm, upcountry-resort feel · but to be straight, the noted point is a language barrier with some staff, especially at the front desk, which can make communicating certain details less smooth, and service standards aren't always equally consistent every time · overall, service still counts as a strength of the resort, and it's one reason many guests forgive the limits around its age and location — because they get genuine friendliness and care in return.

What real reviews say (the good and the bad) — pulling together TripAdvisor, Booking.com, Agoda, and Trip.com, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: the quiet and privacy of Dolphin Bay beach, the roughly 72-metre pool you can really swim in, the calm private beach in front of the resort, the spacious and private pool villas and beach villas, the tasty restaurant food and decent breakfast, friendly and attentive staff, and the closeness to Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park · On the watch-out side: the most talked-about issue is the age of the rooms and furniture, which look dated with signs of wear in places, and some older reviews even complain about bed cleanliness · next is a remote, very quiet location with no public transport and no shops within walking distance of the resort, private pools in some pool villas smaller than expected, Wi-Fi that's unstable in some spots, beach cleanliness that at times has litter, the language barrier with staff, and prices that some feel are set high relative to the resort's actual condition · most of these criticisms come down to setting expectations right — come knowing this is an old-style seaside resort in a quiet corner, not a brand-new luxury stay, and you can be happy with it.

"The pool really is very long, such a pleasure to swim, and the kids could play in the water all day. The beach in front of the resort is super quiet, perfect for relaxing · the only downside is the rooms look a bit dated, the furniture is old, and the Wi-Fi works sometimes and not others. Next time I'll ask for a renovated room."

Price and value — beach villas start at around ฿3,000/night at standard and promotional rates, climbing on weekends, long holidays, and high season · the pool villas with private pools start higher again, depending on size and time of year · compared with beachfront resorts around Sam Roi Yot–Pranburi, The Privacy Beach Resort feels good value for staying right on a quiet private beach, plus a 72-metre pool that's rare at ordinary resorts · measured on the private seaside location and the pool area, this price is reasonable · but measured on how new the rooms are, the quality of the furniture, and how polished the facilities feel, you have to accept there are newer resorts around Pranburi that offer rooms in better shape for a similar budget · in other words, the value here depends on what you weight most — if you weight location, a private beach, and a long pool, this is a good-value pick, but if you weight newness and polish, compare it with other places in the area before deciding.

Good to know before booking — a few things make the stay go more smoothly · one, get your transport sorted, because the Dolphin Bay area has no public transport and there are no shops within walking distance of the resort — you'll want your own car or a rental, and buy the essentials in advance · two, if you expect a room in good shape, ask about it or request photos of the room type you'll be staying in before booking, and pick a recently renovated room or villa if there's an option, since the earliest, older rooms can look dated · three, if you're set on really enjoying a swim, the 72-metre central pool beats the small pools in some pool villas, so factor this in when choosing your room type · four, allow for Wi-Fi that may be unstable in some spots, and bring a backup mobile data SIM if you need to work online · five, plan your meals ahead, allowing for both the resort restaurant and driving out to try local eateries in Sam Roi Yot–Pranburi · six, book ahead for long holidays and high season because villas are limited, and choose free cancellation upfront if your plans aren't firm yet.

The bottom line — from all the real reviews, The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa is the resort that best suits couples and families who want to stay right on a private beach in a quiet setting, love swimming in a long pool, and want to be close to the nature of Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park · its strengths are the quiet, private location on Dolphin Bay beach, a pool roughly 72 metres long that's hard to find, spacious pool villas and beach villas, and friendly, attentive staff, which keep it in the hearts of people after a slow-life seaside break · but if you're after something brand new, polished rooms and furniture, restaurants and cafes within walking distance, or easy travel without a car, this may not be the answer, and you should look at newer resorts around Pranburi or Hua Hin instead · for a trip where you want a private stretch of sea, calm, and a long pool to swim in at an accessible price — The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa fits that need, on the condition that you understand and accept its age and its remote location.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The Privacy Beach Resort & Spa

faq.q: Where is The Privacy Beach Resort · is it far from Hua Hin?
faq.a: The resort sits right on Dolphin Bay beach in Sam Roi Yot sub-district, Sam Roi Yot district, Prachuap Khiri Khan province · from Dolphin Bay into Pranburi town is around 30–40 min by car, and into central Hua Hin around 50–60 min · it's near Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park and Phraya Nakhon Cave · the area is quiet and natural, but there's no public transport and no shops within walking distance of the resort, so you'll want your own car or a rental.

faq.q: Does The Privacy Beach Resort really have a long pool?
faq.a: Yes · the resort's main draw is an outdoor pool roughly 72 metres long running down the middle of the resort, which many reviews praise as satisfying to swim · there's also a separate kids' pool and a poolside bar · the pools in some pool villas are smaller, so if you want to really enjoy a swim, the long central pool is recommended.

faq.q: What's the starting price at The Privacy Beach Resort · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿3,000/night for a beach villa at standard rates, with studio/standard rooms in the main building starting lower · the pool villas with private pools and the two-bedroom villas start higher, depending on size and time of year · there are several room types, from studios and twins to beach villas and pool villas · it's worth comparing several platforms and booking ahead over holidays.

faq.q: Who is The Privacy Beach Resort for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples and families who want to stay right on a private beach in a quiet setting, love swimming in a long pool, and want to be close to the nature of Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park and enjoy a slow-life trip · if you're after buzz, restaurants and cafes within walking distance, or expect brand-new polished rooms, a resort in central Hua Hin or a newer resort in Pranburi may suit you better.

faq.q: Are the rooms at The Privacy Beach Resort old?
faq.a: According to real reviews, some of the rooms and furniture are starting to show their age and look dated in line with the resort's vintage, with old-style decor and, in some rooms, signs of wear and the damp you get at seaside resorts · it's worth asking about it or requesting photos of the room type you'll stay in before booking, and choosing a recently renovated room or villa if there's an option · the offsetting strengths are the private beachfront location, the long pool, and the friendly staff.

faq.q: What restaurants and attractions are around The Privacy Beach Resort?
faq.a: The resort has the Siam Dining restaurant serving Thai and international food, plus a poolside bar · since there aren't many restaurants within walking distance of the resort, many guests rely on the resort restaurant or drive out to find local eateries in Sam Roi Yot–Pranburi · for attractions, the highlights are Khao Sam Roi Yot National Park, Phraya Nakhon Cave, and the mangrove forest trail, all a short drive away.
